# Implementation Plan: Static TODO List App (iOS Native)

**Branch**: `001-static-todo-app` | **Date**: 2026-05-29 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-static-todo-app/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-plan`.

---

## Summary

Build a fully offline, native iOS TODO app that allows users to create, manage, complete,
prioritise, and edit tasks. Data persists locally across app sessions via SwiftData.
The architecture follows Clean Architecture with MVVM using SwiftUI and Swift 6 strict
concurrency — all mandated by the project constitution.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Swift 6.0

**Primary Dependencies**: SwiftUI (UI), SwiftData (persistence), XCTest + XCUITest (testing) — Apple SDK only; zero third-party packages

**Storage**: SwiftData (local on-device), `@Model` classes with in-memory container for tests

**Testing**: XCTest (unit — Domain/Data layers), XCUITest (UI — P1 acceptance scenarios)

**Target Platform**: iOS 17.0+ (iPhone, portrait + landscape)

**Project Type**: Native iOS mobile app

**Performance Goals**: Smooth 60 fps scrolling with up to 500 tasks; UI interactions respond within 300 ms

**Constraints**: Offline-only; no networking; no third-party dependencies; Swift 6 strict concurrency (`SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete`)

**Scale/Scope**: Single user, single device; up to 500 tasks for v1

---

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

Verify compliance with all five constitution principles before proceeding:

- [x] **P-I SwiftUI-First**: All UI implemented in SwiftUI; no UIKit unless documented exception.
- [x] **P-II Clean Architecture/MVVM**: Domain layer has zero framework imports; layer dependency direction correct.
- [x] **P-III SwiftData**: Persistence uses SwiftData `@Model`; no CoreData or custom file I/O for task data.
- [x] **P-IV Swift 6 Concurrency**: `SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete`; no DispatchQueue or callbacks in new code.
- [x] **P-V Offline-First**: No URLSession or networking code; zero external dependencies.

✅ **All gates pass**. No violations. Complexity Tracking table not required.

**Structure Decision**: Single Xcode project (no SPM local packages) with Clean Architecture

## Phase 1: Design & Contracts

**Status**: ✅ Complete

### Data Model
See [data-model.md](data-model.md) for full entity definitions, validation rules,
and SwiftData `@Model` specification.

**Key entity summary**:
- `Task` domain struct: `id`, `title`, `note?`, `priority`, `isCompleted`, `createdAt`, `completedAt?`
- `Priority` enum: `.none`, `.low`, `.medium`, `.high` with `Comparable` conformance
- `TaskDataModel` SwiftData `@Model`: mirrors domain entity; `priority` stored as `Int` rawValue

### UI Contracts
See [contracts/ui-contracts.md](contracts/ui-contracts.md) for screen-level input/output
contracts, state variants, ViewModel interfaces, and navigation map.

**Screens**: `TaskListView` · `AddTaskView` · `EditTaskView`

### Quickstart
See [quickstart.md](quickstart.md) for project setup, Xcode configuration, SwiftLint
setup, running tests, and the MVP smoke-test checklist.

## Constitution Check (Post-Design)

Re-evaluation after Phase 1 design:

- [x] **P-I SwiftUI-First**: All 3 screens are pure SwiftUI. No UIKit bridging identified.
- [x] **P-II Clean Architecture/MVVM**: Domain `Task` and `Priority` have zero framework imports. Repositories accessed via protocol. ViewModels depend only on use cases.
- [x] **P-III SwiftData**: `TaskDataModel` is the sole persistence surface. `ModelContainer` created once at app entry.
- [x] **P-IV Swift 6 Concurrency**: ViewModel methods declared `async`. `@MainActor` isolation on `@Observable` VMs. No GCD usage.
- [x] **P-V Offline-First**: No network calls, no external packages.

✅ **All post-design gates pass.**
